answer_1.quote: Response Generation integrates retrieved memory information to generate coherent and personalized responses ... enabling the generation of contextually coherent and personalized responses.

answer_2.quote: For the GVD dataset, we use three evaluation metrics: Memory Retrieval Accuracy (Acc.), Response Correctness (Corr.), and Contextual Coherence (Cohe.). ... On the LoCoMo benchmark, standard F1 and BLEU-1 are employed to evaluate the model's performance.

answer_3.quote: All evaluations on the GVD dataset are automatically scored by the DeepSeek-R1.
